name: learn
description: Teach anything so it locks in: probe, plan and teach one reasoning step at a time, graded quizzes with confidence, practice sessions, and a knowledge graph in your Obsidian vault. Ported from LearnHarness.

learnDir.title: Learning folder
learnDir.description: Your learning vault: lesson notes go in its logs/ folder when a session runs outside any vault, and the knowledge graph lives in its graph/ folder.

graphModel.title: Graph extraction model
graphModel.description: The model that extracts propositions into the knowledge graph: an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id.

askConfidence.title: Ask confidence after each quiz
askConfidence.description: After each graded pick, ask how sure you were (and take your thinking) before revealing the verdict.
